phase: Phase 1: CI mode and the local pin refresh (target 2026-11-12)
summary: Security points 1, 2, 4, and 5 pass on machine evidence. Point 3 fails: the v2 reconcile route writes the four v2 artifacts from a candidate manifest with zero review records, and the only control is a self-asserted owner plus rationale on each new entry. A latent defect blocks any honest acceptance while the staged delta is non-empty. No tenant, secret, or personal data is in scope. Audit only; no repository file was edited.
blocking_findings: F1 high: an unreviewed candidate manifest can write the four v2 artifacts. applyArchitectureReconciliation no longer requires policyStatus accepted (packages/architecture-enforcement/src/architecture-reconciliation.ts:1206-1235). The committed manifest is candidate with reviews=[] and a staged delta of 255 additions, 15 removals, and 162 renames, and commit 863841016 wrote the v2 baselines under it. The remaining guards are exact plan-hash equality, v2-only, the exact four-path destination set, an identical fresh preview, and a self-asserted --owner plus --rationale per new entry. No test proves that an unreviewed write is refused; architecture-v2-route-14d.test.ts:561 asserts only the absence of one error message. Route to Green, then to the owner: restore a review-artifact gate for writes with non-empty deltas, or record the owner decision that self-attested owner plus rationale is the accepted control.
nonblocking_findings: F2 medium: validateReviewSync and the owner-receipt check require baselineAdditions, baselineRemovals, and baselineRenames to be empty arrays (packages/architecture-enforcement/src/v2-manifest-validation.ts:656 and :819), but the review subject now covers non-empty staged deltas, so the accepted path demands evidence that states a falsehood. The policy stays candidate with default v1, so CI must keep the explicit --policy v2.

F3 low: measure/tracks.md:80 names only --skip-input-snapshot-pin, while .github/workflows/ci.yml:176 now runs pnpm architecture:check --skip-input-snapshot-pin --policy v2. This is an understatement, not an overstatement, so the A6 check finds no claim that outruns the implementation.

F4 low: parseArchitectureReconciliationArguments accepts any non-empty --owner and --rationale and validates them only when a new entry is built (baselineEntrySchema.parse in reviewedEntryForFinding). The values are data only and reach no path or shell call, so there is no injection path. An early pattern check would give a clearer refusal.
